name: Kingfisher Villa Suites
positioning: An intimate villa-suite safari retreat in the Waterberg.
experience: Villa suites, considered interiors and a quieter lodge setting.
character: Botanical restraint: forest green, leaf gold, fine serif contrast and generous light space.

photoStyle: Architecture and furnished outdoor living; clean daylight, no people.
headline: A quieter kind of safari
copy: Explore Kingfisher Villa Suites, where considered spaces meet the Waterberg bush.
photoCaption: Pool and lounge at Kingfisher Villa Suites

journeyDirectionR2.arrival: Framed villa view with inset caption and vertical square controls; booking column on the right.
journeyDirectionR2.later: Suite dossier: description, information links and separate rate rail; light inset detail panels.

photoStyle: Canvas accommodation among trees; warm natural light, no people.

journeyDirectionR2.later: Sequential room blocks and a broad rate/action band; dashed section dividers and stacked map/facts.

name: Hoyo Hoyo Safari Lodge
positioning: A warm African-style lodge on the Mluwati River in Kruger National Park.
experience: Thatched rondavels, earthy interiors and a welcoming lodge atmosphere.
character: Burnt orange blocks, upright condensed headings and tactile earthy light surfaces, directly informed by the site.
composition: Architectural hero with attached burnt-orange caption and square controls; bold booking block on the left.
photoStyle: Recognisable thatched architecture and burnt-orange details; no people or invented cultural motifs.
tone: Warm, direct and welcoming; avoid invented translations or cultural claims.
headline: A warm welcome to the wild
copy: Thatched peaks and earthy colours meet the Kruger bush at Hoyo Hoyo Safari Lodge.
photoCaption: Thatched lodge exterior at Hoyo Hoyo
initialR1Composition: Compact asymmetric header; broad burnt-orange navigation; a strong vertical colour edge on the booking panel and a full-width warm welcome band under the image. Angular rather than softly rounded.

journeyDirectionR2.arrival: Architectural hero with attached burnt-orange caption and square controls; bold booking block on the left.
journeyDirectionR2.later: Strong property/section headers, accent rail, segmented detail links and paired policy blocks.
journeyDirectionR2.mobile: Photograph then booking and welcome copy; segmented information links wrap while preserving every control.
journeyDirectionR2.background: Warm surface with a narrow burnt-orange edge.

photoStyle: Furnished lodge spaces, timber and quiet hospitality details; no people.
